name: sagemaker-edge
description: SageMaker Edge Manager dataplane service for communicating with active agents

subcommands.name: get-deployments
subcommands.description: Use to get the active deployments from a device

options.name: --device-name
options.description: The unique name of the device you want to get the configuration of active deployments from

options.name: --device-fleet-name
options.description: The name of the fleet that the device belongs to

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
